position_disposition_kind_reason_check.name: position_disposition_kind_reason_check
position_disposition_kind_reason_check.value:
("position_disposition"."kind" = 'set_aside' AND "position_disposition"."set_aside_reason_id" IS NOT NULL AND "position_disposition"."rejection_reason_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("position_disposition"."kind" = 'rejected' AND "position_disposition"."rejection_reason_id" IS NOT NULL AND "position_disposition"."set_aside_reason_id" IS NULL)

public.pending_rescore.definition:
select "rescore_request"."id" as "rescore_request_id", "position"."id" as "position_id" from "rescore_request" inner join "position" on "position"."seen_at" >= "rescore_request"."since_date" where not exists (
        select 1 from "position_score"
        where ("position_score"."position_id" = "position"."id" and "position_score"."criteria_set_id" = "rescore_request"."criteria_set_id")
      )
public.pending_rescore.name: pending_rescore

public.position_first_touch.definition: select distinct on ("origin"."position_id") "position_id", "id" as "origin_id", "route_id", "touched_on" from "origin" where "origin"."position_id" IS NOT NULL AND "origin"."touched_on" <= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'utc')::date order by "origin"."position_id", "origin"."touched_on", "origin"."recorded_at", "origin"."id"
public.position_first_touch.name: position_first_touch
